issues: Three 50f segments joined by crossfades, each starting and stopping on its own, so it read as three spliced shots rather than one continuous flight
A pale grey UI on near-black, with a full-screen blur duplicate and a heavy vignette turning the bright surface muddy grey
Floating was faked with 2D offsets and the shadow was a grey ghost stuck in place, so neither height nor light direction made sense
Placeholder grey UI copied from the reference (sidebar tree, list) with no hierarchy or accent; nothing told you what to read first
changes: Sand look (beige, terracotta): the UI becomes terrain lit by a low warm sun, with warm aerial haze, a backdrop-blur band for depth of field and a warm glow top left

One continuous rising take: the focus follows a cubic Bezier from the sidebar tree across the task list to the 220px 'Launch plan' title, with ease-in 25% / cruise / ease-out 30%, heading −10° to −20° and pitch 64° to 54° at the end

Real 3D floating: about 60 text, icon and badge units lift 120–230px along the surface normal; shadows sit on the surface offset 0.75×height along the light direction, large and soft when high, tight when close
Landing times come from the camera path: each element lands when the focus gets within 120px, so the first passed lands first, 22f accelerating falls overlap, and the title lands last and heaviest

A purpose-built fictional product 'Orchard': brand, nav, SPACES tree and eight task rows with status pills, avatars and dates, all at 56–84px; terracotta only for the selection, 'In review' and progress
165f: the flight ends by 140f and the last 25f hold on the title poster
